title: Omulwadde Atawuguka
intro: Mu bitabo by’ebyafaayo by’obunnabbi, batono abagumidde okufiirwa okw’amaanyi n’okubonaabona okw’omubiri bwe kutyo n’okukkiriza okutakankana. Emboozi ya ffiga eno ssomo eritaggwaawo mu bugumiikiriza n’okwesiga amagezi ag’obwakatonda. Omwoyo guno y’ani?
clues: Nalondebwa Allah okutuusa obubaka, naye ekigezo kyange ekisinga obunene tekyajja mu kugaana, wabula mu kabi ak’obuntu.
Eby’obugagga byange, ebisolo byange n’abaana bange byanzigyako, omu oluvannyuma lw’omulala.
Omubiri gwange gwali gujjudde amabwa, era nnasigala nzekka okuggyako obuwagizi bwa munnange.
Nakaabira Mukama wange, nga nkiriza okubonaabona kwange era nga nnoonya okusaasira kwe.
Nalagirwa okukuba ettaka n’ekigere kyange, era ensulo eyali ezzaamu amaanyi n’ekulukuta.
Allah yanzizaamu obulamu bwange n’ampa amaka amapya n’obugagga n’okusinga bwe nnalina edda.
